cases.title: A team member who is not the manager cannot approve a request
cases.given: A pending request and a signed-in team member whose email is not MANAGER_EMAIL
cases.when: That team member sends an approve decision for the request
then: The app refuses with a not-allowed response
The request stays pending

cases.title: A visitor who is not signed in is sent to Google sign-in
cases.when: It opens the app's home page or the manager's pending list
then: It is redirected to the Google sign-in page
No request data appears in the page

cases.title: A request with the end date before the start date is rejected
cases.when: They submit start date 2026-08-10 and end date 2026-08-05
then: The form shows 'The end date must be on or after the start date'
No request is saved

cases.title: End to end: submit, approve, see approved, receive email
cases.given: A signed-in team member and the manager, with the email service replaced by a test double
cases.when: The team member submits 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-14, and the manager approves it
then: The team member's list shows the request as approved
One approval email with those dates was sent to the team member

cases.title: A real request is approved in the deployed app
cases.given: The app deployed on Vercel and the user signed in with their company Google account
cases.when: They submit one real request and the manager approves it
then: The requester receives the approval email
The requester sees approved in the app

cases.title: An account outside the company domain is refused
then: Sign-in is refused with a message
No request data is shown

cases.title: A submitted request is saved as pending
cases.when: They submit start date 2026-09-01, end date 2026-09-05 and comment 'Family trip'
then: One request matching S-001 is saved with status pending
It holds the team member's email and name, and those dates and comment

cases.title: A request overlapping the person's own request is rejected
cases.given: A team member with an approved request from 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-14
cases.when: They submit a new request from 2026-08-10 to 2026-08-20
then: The form shows a message that it overlaps an existing request
Nothing new is saved

cases.title: A team member sees their own requests with status
cases.given: A team member with one pending, one approved and one rejected request with reason 'Team is short that week'
then: The three requests appear with dates and status
The rejected one shows the reason

cases.title: A team member never sees another person's requests
cases.given: Team member A with one request and team member B with one request
cases.when: A opens their requests list, and A asks for B's request by its id
then: A's list holds only A's request
The request for B's id is refused

cases.title: A team member cancels their own pending request
cases.given: A team member with a pending request
then: Its status becomes cancelled
It disappears from the manager's pending list

cases.title: The manager sees all pending requests
cases.given: Two pending requests from different team members and one approved request
cases.when: The manager opens the pending list
then: Exactly the two pending requests appear
They are ordered oldest first, with name, dates and comment

cases.title: The manager rejects with a reason and the requester is told why
cases.given: A pending request and the email service replaced by a test double
cases.when: The manager rejects it with reason 'Team is short that week'
then: The request status is rejected with that reason
One rejection email containing the reason was sent to the requester

cases.title: A request cannot be decided twice
cases.given: A request the manager has already approved
cases.when: The manager sends a reject decision for the same request
then: The request stays approved
No second decision email is sent

cases.title: The manager is emailed about a new request
cases.given: The email service replaced by a test double
cases.when: A team member submits a request from 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-03
then: One email with the requester's name and those dates was sent to MANAGER_EMAIL

cases.title: An email failure is retried 3 times and logged
cases.given: The email service test double fails on every send
cases.when: The manager approves a pending request
then: The send was tried 3 times in total
One failure is logged
The request still shows approved in the app

cases.title: Google sign-in down shows a clear message
cases.given: The Google sign-in provider returns an error
cases.when: A visitor tries to sign in
then: The page shows 'Sign-in is unavailable, try again later'
No request data changes

cases.title: Nobody can delete a request
cases.given: A request and a signed-in manager
cases.when: A delete is attempted on that request through the app's API
then: The app refuses
The request still exists unchanged
